subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Recipient], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking for your upcoming trip to Paris. Your flight details are as follows: Flight: ABC123 Date: 15th August 2022 Departure: 10:00 AM We hope you have a pleasant journey and look forward to welcoming you on board. Should you have any questions or require further assistance, please do not hesitate to contact us. Safe travels! Best regards, The Travel Agency Team
